Alice M: CI red on PR #412 — integration matrix failed on linux-3 / py39 + postgres. Looks like a timeout in test_connect. Anyone able to kick a narrow rerun?
Caroline (qa): saw that locally flaked once for me too. If it's just that axis we can retrigger only the failing job.
Ben (infra): you can target a single axis with the retry tool: `ci retry --pipeline=integration --job=linux-3 --axis=py39,postgres` — that will avoid rebuilding images.
Alice M: nice, does that preserve the build artifacts? don't want a full image rebuild during the retrigger.
Ben (infra): right — default is no image rebuild for targeted job-level retries. for a rebuild-only you'd use `ci rerun --rebuild-images --pipeline=integration --job=linux-3`.
Jenna S: if you just want to rerun the job but force a clean workspace: `ci retry --job=linux-3 --clean-workspace` (this keeps image but clears caches).
Alice M: thanks. any slack slash commands for non-cli folks?
Ben (infra): yep `/ci retry job=linux-3 axis=py39,postgres` — bot will post the new run id. perms follow the same roles as CLI.
ci-bot: Trigger request received by @Alice M — queued retry for integration/linux-3 (axis: py39,postgres). new pipeline id: 789012.
Caroline (qa): if it fails again and looks like a regression open a bisect request (mention @Ben). we can run a quick binary search across recent commits.
Alice M: retriggered via slash command — thanks everyone. I'll monitor logs and post back. :thumbsup:
Jenna S: one quick tip — if flaky timeouts recur, add `--flaky-retries=2` to the job config temporarily while debugging. helps avoid noise.
Alice M: noted. If the retry clears I'll merge; if not I'll ping infra for a bisect.
Ben (infra): sounds good — ping me if you want a rebuild-only run or help with the bisect script (`./tools/bisect_ci.sh`).
Alice M: closing loop: retry passed on pipeline 789012, merging now. Thanks all!
